chivalry.lineNext: I hold the door open and let her pass through
stanza: I hold the door open and let her pass through
She says, "Thanks" to me in a British accent
And I try to answer her in the same voice
She laughs at me, says, "What was that supposed to be?"
I say, "I'm sorry, I'm from a different part of the country"

chivalry.linePrev: Honey, you're familiar like my mirror years ago
chivalry.line: Idealism sits in prison, chivalry fell on his sword
chivalry.lineNext: Innocence died screaming, honey, ask me, I should know
